verdict.rationale: Reclaim offers Scheduling Links for bookings, so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows bookings flowing into Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, or any CRM or automation platform. The documented integrations (Slack status sync, Google Calendar/Gmail add-ons, task sync from Todoist/Asana/Jira and others) are adjacent features that earn no credit. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.
